_comment: A worked example of a Tokenbrawl CLI run config (Story 5.1).
npm run tokenbrawl -w packages/cli -- tournament --config tokenbrawl.example.json
There is no field for an API key and there will not be one. Each Deployment
names an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE via apiKeyEnv; the key is read from the
environment only, never written to a log, and redacted from anything the
command prints. A config file gets committed, pasted into an issue and
copied between machines -- a key belongs in none of those.
seedBase/seedCount define the seed range. A tournament plays every unordered
pair of the agents below once per seed, and writes one Command Log per Match
into outputDir. Re-running the same command completes only what is missing:
the committed logs ARE the progress (AD-9).
The deployment entry is commented out by being absent rather than present:
add it back once GROQ_API_KEY is exported.
